# CBB backtest: every table (generated by evaluate.py; REPORT.md has the summary)

pts = results model (points scored), market = ratings fit to earlier games' closing lines, blend = their average. Spreads: play when |model margin + opener| >= gap. CLV = opener vs DK/FD/BetMGM median close (points, + = good). xCLV = CLV minus the average drift for that kind of side (favourite/underdog x home/away/neutral, over/under) in the same season and period. ATS graded at the opener, -110.
